title: Nourishing Golden Peruvian Chicken Pollo A La Brasa
description: A cultured and festive Peruvian dish featuring creamed corn and dashi extract, made with low fat friendly ingredients, this Pollo A La Brasa is a delicious and nutritious meal option. It is a traditional Peruvian roasted chicken dish marinated in a mixture of spices and herbs.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blended spice mixture, olive oil, and dashi extract.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, heat the cream corn in a saucepan over medium heat.
After the chicken has roasted for 30 minutes, brush it with the heated cream corn and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
